query: I have a 53-year-old man with upper GI bleeding. Among male ICU patients aged 48–58 with UGIB, stratify first 24‑hour diagnostic procedure counts into quintiles and report average procedures, hospital LOS (days), and in‑hospital mortality (%) per quintile.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.age, i.icustay_id, i.intime, i.outtime, i.los, d.interpretation, COUNT(p.subject_id) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id, i.icustay_id, i.intime, i.outtime, i.los, d.interpretation ORDER BY p.subject_id) AS procedure_count, COUNT(p.subject_id) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id, i.icustay_id, i.intime, i.outtime, i.los, d.interpretation ORDER BY p.subject_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS procedure_count_within_first_24_hours, percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id ORDER BY p.dod) AS mortality_percentage_rank FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON p.subject_id = d.subject_id AND d.icd_code = 'UGIB' WHERE p.age BETWEEN 48 AND 58 AND p.gender = 'M' AND d.interpretation = 'S' AND i.intime <= '2020-01-01' AND (i.outtime >= '2020-01-01' OR i.outtime IS NULL) AND (p.dod >= '2020-01-01' OR p.dod IS NULL) AND (i.los >= 0 OR i.los IS NULL) ORDER BY p.subject_id, procedure_count_within_first_24_hours NULLS LAST;
